title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
title_zh: 生成音乐一致的3D舞蹈：基于层次空间-时间建模的BeatDance框架

paragraphs.en: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets. The project page is available at https://shenxiaojian.github.io/BeatDance/ .
paragraphs.zh: 根据音乐生成逼真的三维舞蹈是一项具有挑战性的任务，它既需要与音乐节奏精准同步，又要捕捉人类动作的空间复杂性。 尽管现有方法能够生成物理上合理的舞蹈动作，但它们往往难以与音乐（例如节拍）实现精确对齐。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的新框架 BeatDance，包含两个组成部分：1) 我们提出了一种分层解耦注意力（HDA）模块，该模块首先将人类姿态的学习与时间动态分离。 随后采用分层结构来捕捉短期和长期依赖关系，从而增强时空建模能力；2) 我们通过引入一个辅助的舞蹈到音乐转换模块来实现循环一致性学习。 在训练过程中，重建音乐与原始音乐之间的差异会产生更强的损失信号，从而有效促进音乐与舞蹈动作之间的一致性。 广泛的实验结果表明，我们提出的方法在两个基准数据集上的表现优于近期的先进方法。 项目页面请访问 https://shenxiaojian.github.io/BeatDance/ 。

paragraphs.en: Music plays an important role in shaping emotions and narratives, which are often embodied through human motion. This natural connection has inspired growing interest in generating 3D dance conditioned on the music. Automated motion synthesis from music reduces reliance on motion-capture systems and costly animation tools, enabling more efficient content creation across various applications such as film-making [ 7 , 40 ] , virtual production [ 11 ] , and video editing [ 42 , 37 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 音乐在塑造情感和叙事方面扮演着重要角色，而这些情感和叙事通常通过人类动作得以体现。 这种天然的联系激发了人们日益浓厚的兴趣，即根据音乐生成三维舞蹈。 从音乐中自动合成动作可以减少对动作捕捉系统和昂贵动画工具的依赖，从而更高效地创作内容，适用于电影制作 [ 7 , 40 ]、虚拟制作 [ 11 ] 和视频编辑 [ 42 , 37 ] 等多种应用。

paragraphs.en: To achieve high-quality dance generation, many works leverage the autoencoder [ 30 , 45 ] as a core component of the model architecture. Bailando [ 31 ] models the upper and lower body motions separately using VQ-VAE, and generates motion code indices auto-regressively. TM2D [ 5 ] combines the training of music-to-dance and text-to-motion, which helps produce smoother dance motion. Recently, diffusion models have shown remarkable proficiency in music-driven 3D dance generation [ 49 , 19 , 18 , 38 ] . For example, EDGE [ 35 ] proposes to use Jukebox [ 3 ] to extract music features, and the model also supports dance editing, dance completion, and joint in-painting. POPDG [ 24 ] proposes a new dataset, i.e ., PopDanceSet, which comprises a wide range of diverse and complex dance motions. It introduces an additional self-attention and an alignment module to learn the relationships among human body parts and insert music features into the model, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现高质量的舞蹈生成，许多研究将自编码器 [ 30 , 45 ] 作为模型架构的核心组件。 Bailando [ 31 ] 使用 VQ-VAE 分别对上半身和下半身的动作进行建模，并以自回归方式生成动作编码索引。 TM2D [ 5 ] 将音乐到舞蹈的生成与文本到动作的生成训练相结合，有助于产生更流畅的舞蹈动作。 最近，扩散模型在音乐驱动的 3D 舞蹈生成方面展现出卓越的能力 [ 49 , 19 , 18 , 38 ] 。 例如，EDGE [ 35 ] 提出使用 Jukebox [ 3 ] 提取音乐特征，该模型还支持舞蹈编辑、舞蹈补全和关节区域修复。 POPDG [ 24 ] 提出了一个新的数据集，即 PopDanceSet，其中包含了广泛多样且复杂的舞蹈动作。 它引入了一个额外的自注意力模块和一个对齐模块，分别用于学习人体各部分之间的关系，并将音乐特征注入模型中。

paragraphs.en: Despite the encouraging progress, these methods still face challenges in generation precision. First, they only perform a coarse-grained fusion of music and motion features without explicitly modeling the spatial-temporal dependencies simultaneously between music and dance, which lead to beat misalignment (such as POPDG illustrated in Figure 1 (a)). Second, these works typically focus on long-term dependency, overlooking the short-term patterns that are crucial for maintaining motion continuity and synchronizing with local-level musical beats.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了令人鼓舞的进展，但这些方法在生成精度方面仍面临挑战。 首先，它们仅对音乐和动作特征进行粗略融合，而未明确同时建模音乐与舞蹈之间的时空依赖关系，这会导致节拍错位（例如图 1(a) 中所示的 POPDG）。 其次，这些研究通常关注长期依赖，而忽视了维持动作连续性和与局部音乐节拍同步所至关重要的短期模式。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we propose BeatDance, a diffusion-based framework for music-driven 3D dance generation. At the core of this framework is our proposed Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which consists of two components. First, we present a decoupled attention that explicitly separates the learning of spatial and temporal information. Specifically, the spatial attention divides the body into several anatomical parts, each with an independent linear projection. For the temporal dynamics, we update the temporal feature by applying a Taylor series expansion over a learned joint music-dance attention map. Second, we employ a hierarchical design that organizes these motion features from local to global levels for short-term and long-term dependencies. This design provides the capacity to model fine-grained music-dance correspondences across multiple temporal scales. Meanwhile, to further exploit this capacity, we introduce a dance-to-music branch based on a latent diffusion model. We perform cycle-consistent learning to map dance motion back to its corresponding music, which improves the alignment between the two modalities. The improved music-dance alignment is particularly reflected in more accurate beat synchronization. It also benefits broader aspects of dance quality: the part-specific spatial modeling facilitates the learning of complex dance poses and expressive whole-body movements, while the short-term and long-term temporal modeling promote smooth transitions and choreographic coherence, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 BeatDance——一个基于扩散模型的音乐驱动三维舞蹈生成框架。 该框架的核心是我们提出的分层解耦注意力机制（HDA），它由两个组件构成。 首先，我们提出了一种解耦注意力机制，能够明确分离空间信息与时间信息的学習过程。 具体而言，空间注意力将身体划分为多个解剖学部位，每个部位都拥有独立的线性投影。 对于时间动态，我们通过在一个可学习的音乐-舞蹈注意力映射上应用泰勒级数展开来更新时间特征。 其次，我们采用分层设计，将这些运动特征从局部层次组织到全局层次，以处理短期和长期依赖关系。 这种设计具备在多个时间尺度上建模精细音乐-舞蹈对应关系的能力。 同时，为了进一步利用这一能力，我们引入了一个基于潜在扩散模型的舞蹈到音乐分支。 我们通过循环一致性学習将舞蹈动作映射回其对应的音乐，从而提升两种模态之间的对齐度。 改进的音乐-舞蹈对齐尤其体现在更精确的节拍同步上。 它也有助于提升舞蹈质量的更多方面：针对特定部位的空间建模有助于学習复杂的舞蹈姿势和富有表现力的全身动作，而短期与长期的时间建模则分别促进了动作的流畅过渡和编舞的整体连贯性。

paragraphs.en: Text-driven motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motion from a text description. Early works [ 28 , 8 ] directly deploy a text encoder and a motion decoder to learn the mapping from the two modalities. Recently, some works [ 23 , 29 ] employ a Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) [ 36 ] to project human motions into discrete representations. For example, T2M-GPT [ 51 ] encodes motion sequences into discrete tokens using VQ-VAE and then learns to map text descriptions to these tokens with a Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT). paragraphs.en: Music-driven dance generation is challenging due to its demand for complex articulation and precise music-dance alignment. Early methods [ 17 , 27 ] , which rely on similarity-based retrieval and concatenation from existing databases, are inherently limited in generating novel dance motions. With the advent of deep learning, extensive efforts [ 39 , 10 , 21 , 15 ] have been made to model the probabilistic mapping between music and dance. Among these advances, VQ-VAEs have emerged as an effective tool for learning discrete motion representations. For example, Bailando [ 31 , 32 ] encodes motion into discrete codes and uses a GPT-style autoregressive decoder to generate upper- and lower-body movements, with a reinforcement-learning-based scheme for beat alignment. Similarly, TM2D [ 5 ] utilizes a shared VQ-VAE codebook for both music-to-dance and text-to-motion tasks. By unifying the shared latent space, it benefits from large-scale text-motion datasets, resulting in smoother dance motions. More recently, diffusion models have shown remarkable proficiency in music-driven 3D dance generation [ 49 , 38 , 50 ] , branching into two distinct research directions. One direction focuses on extremely long dance generation via multi-stage architectures [ 19 , 18 ] . For example, Lodge [ 19 ] employs a coarse-to-fine framework to achieve this through cascaded generation processes. Different from these multi-stage approaches, our HDA captures short-term and long-term dependencies within a unified single-stage module, with a particular focus on improving fine-grained music-dance alignment. The other direction explores single-stage frameworks to streamline the generation pipeline. EDGE [ 35 ] is the first to leverage the diffusion model for synthesizing high-fidelity dance in this category. It uses Jukebox [ 3 ] to extract music features, which has become the standard setting for subsequent works. POPDG [ 24 ] proposes PopDanceSet, a dataset of diverse and complex dance motions. It also introduces spatial-temporal attention blocks and an alignment module that modulates dance features through an affine transformation conditioned on music and motion features. By contrast, our HDA explicitly models fine-grained music-dance correspondences. It first partitions the body into anatomical regions with independent projections, allowing different body parts to separately capture their relationships with the music.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we first introduce BeatDance, a diffusion-based framework designed to synthesize realistic and expressive 3D dance sequences that are consistent with the source music. Then we present Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which is used to model the intricate spatial-temporal mappings between generated dance and input music, capturing both short-term and long-term dependencies in a hierarchical fashion. Finally, we propose Cycle-Consistent Learning (CCL) mechanism to reinforce the music-dance consistency by employing an auxiliary dance-to-music model.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们首先介绍 BeatDance——一种基于扩散的框架，旨在合成与源音乐保持一致、真实且富有表现力的三维舞蹈序列。 接着，我们提出分层解耦注意力机制（HDA），用于建模生成的舞蹈与输入音乐之间复杂的时空映射，以分层方式捕捉短期和长期依赖关系。 最后，我们提出了循环一致性学习（CCL）机制，通过引入一个辅助的舞蹈到音乐模型来强化音乐与舞蹈之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: As for the dance-to-music branch, we aim to reconstruct the music from the generated dance motion with a latent diffusion model. Building upon this model, we introduce a cycle-consistent learning strategy to further encourage semantic consistency between the generated 3D dance and the source music. Briefly, we first train the dance-to-music model independently. Once trained, we freeze its parameters and integrate it with the music-to-dance model to form a music-to-dance-to-music cycle. For more details, please refer to Section 4.3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于舞蹈到音乐的分支，我们的目标是通过潜在扩散模型，根据生成的舞蹈动作重构音乐。 基于该模型，我们引入了一种循环一致性学习策略，以进一步促进生成的三维舞蹈与源音乐之间的语义一致性。 简而言之，我们首先独立训练舞蹈到音乐模型。 训练完成后，我们冻结其参数，并将其与音乐到舞蹈模型结合，形成一个音乐到舞蹈再到音乐的循环。 更多细节请参阅第 4.3.1 节。

paragraphs.en: The Cycle-Consistent Learning (CCL) mechanism incorporates a dance-to-music model to enhance temporal consistency between the generated dance sequences and the source music. The motivation is that a high-quality music-driven dance should preserve the information in the source music that is visually reflected by motion, such as rhythmic accents, temporal structure, and motion-related musical semantics. If the generated dance loses these music-related cues, the auxiliary D2M model cannot reconstruct the corresponding music features well. Therefore, reconstructing music features from generated motion provides a direct cross-modal supervision signal, encouraging the dance to preserve music-related information and remain aligned with the input music. Notably, we reconstruct music features rather than raw audio, because music features provide a compact and motion-relevant target while avoiding acoustic details that are weakly reflected by body motion. To achieve this, this mechanism employs an auxiliary task that first generates dance motion from input music, then reconstructs the music features from the generated dance with the dance-to-music model.
paragraphs.zh: 循环一致性学习（CCL）机制引入了一种舞蹈到音乐模型，以增强生成的舞蹈序列与源音乐之间的时间一致性。 其核心动机是：高质量的、由音乐驱动的舞蹈应当保留源音乐中通过动作在视觉上体现的信息，例如节奏重音、时间结构和与动作相关的音乐语义。 如果生成的舞蹈丢失了这些与音乐相关的线索，辅助的 D2M 模型就无法很好地重建相应的音乐特征。 因此，从生成的动作中重建音乐特征能够提供直接的跨模态监督信号，促使舞蹈保留与音乐相关的信息，并与输入音乐保持一致。 值得注意的是，我们重建的是音乐特征而非原始音频，因为音乐特征既提供了紧凑且与动作相关的目标，也避免了那些身体动作难以体现的声学细节。 为实现这一目标，该机制采用了一项辅助任务：首先根据输入音乐生成舞蹈动作，然后利用舞蹈到音乐模型从生成的舞蹈中重建音乐特征。

paragraphs.en: AIST++ [ 20 ] is a large-scale 3D dance motion dataset reconstructed from multi-view dance videos. It contains 1,408 sequences with a total duration of 5.2 hours, covering 10 genres of street dance performed by 30 subjects. The genres span both old-school styles (Break, Pop, Lock, and Waack) and new-school styles (Middle Hip-hop, LA-style Hip-hop, House, Krump, Street Jazz, and Ballet Jazz). Each genre contains both basic (85%) and advanced (15%) choreographies. The accompanying music spans tempos from 80 to 135 BPM. Per-frame annotations include SMPL pose parameters for 24 joints with global translation, and 17 COCO-format joint locations in both 2D and 3D. The dataset is carefully split to ensure no overlap of music or choreography between training and test sets. Following [ 35 ] , we adopt the same split and preprocessing, adjusting all training samples to 5 seconds at 30 fps.

paragraphs.en: PopDanceSet [ 24 ] is a more recent dataset designed to reflect the aesthetic preferences of contemporary audiences. It is constructed by filtering dance videos from a popular online platform using a popularity function. Compared to AIST++, PopDanceSet spans a broader range of dance styles and music genres, and features more intricate choreographic movements, posing greater challenges for music-dance alignment. For fair comparison, we follow its official data split and process all samples to 5 seconds at 30 fps.

paragraphs.en: All experiments are conducted on 4 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Our framework consists of two branches: the music-to-dance (M2D) generation branch and the auxiliary dance-to-music (D2M) branch used for cycle-consistent learning. We describe the implementation details of each branch below.
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均在 4 块 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上进行。 我们的框架由两个分支组成：音乐到舞蹈（M2D）生成分支，以及用于循环一致性学习的辅助舞蹈到音乐（D2M）分支。 我们在下文描述了每个分支的实现细节。

sents.en: We describe the implementation details of each branch below.

paragraphs.en: The dance feature vector comprises 156 dimensions: a 3-dimensional root joint translation, 6-DoF rotations for 24 SMPL body joints (144 dimensions in total), and 9 binary contact indicators for the feet, hands, and neck. For the Hierarchical Decoupled Attention module, the 24 body joints are partitioned into N s = 8 N_{s}{=}8 groups: 7 functionally relevant regions incorporating the head, spine, left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, and root joint, along with an additional global full-body part. Each group is processed by an independent linear projection to preserve part-specific motion characteristics.
paragraphs.zh: 舞蹈特征向量包含 156 个维度：一个 3 维的根关节平移、24 个 SMPL 身体关节的 6-DoF 旋转（总计 144 个维度），以及用于脚部、手部和颈部的 9 个二进制接触指示器。 对于分层解耦注意力模块，24 个身体关节被划分为 N_{s}=8 个组：7 个功能相关的区域，包括头部、脊柱、左臂、右臂、左腿、右腿和根关节，以及一个额外的全局全身部分。 每个组都由一个独立的线性投影处理，以保留各身体部分的特定运动特性。

These embeddings encode rich semantic and rhythmic information from the raw audio, providing a strong conditioning signal for the M2D generation branch. All music clips are processed at 30 fps to match the dance frame rate, yielding 150 frames per 5-second clip.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用预训练的 Jukebox [ 3 ] 模型来提取音乐特征，从而每帧得到 4,800 维的嵌入向量。 这些嵌入向量编码了原始音频中丰富的语义和节奏信息，为 M2D 生成分支提供了强有力的条件信号。 所有音乐片段都以 30 fps 进行处理，以匹配舞蹈的帧率，因此每段 5 秒的音频会生成 150 帧。

paragraphs.en: The M2D diffusion model adopts a cosine-based variance schedule with a cosine offset of 0.008 and sets the total denoising steps T T to 1000. The denoising network is a 6-layer Transformer with latent dimensions of 8 × 64 8{\times}64 , where 8 corresponds to the number of body parts and 64 is the per-part feature dimensionality. The local hierarchical window size τ \tau is set to 30 frames, and the Taylor series expansion order for the temporal attention map is set to 3, both determined through ablation studies (Table 4 and Table 5 ). During training, we use the Adan [ 44 ] optimizer with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2{\times}10^{-4} , a weight decay of 0.02, and a batch size of 128. During inference, we employ DDIM sampling with 50 steps, which reduces inference time by 20 × 20{\times} relative to standard DDPM sampling while maintaining comparable generation quality.

paragraphs.en: The D2M branch synthesizes audio represented as mel-spectrograms with 256 Mel-frequency bands. The VAE encoder and decoder each consist of four convolutional blocks for progressive downsampling and upsampling, respectively, compressing the mel-spectrogram into a compact latent representation. The latent diffusion model adopts a U-Net architecture with a four-layer convolutional encoder and a symmetric four-layer decoder connected via skip connections, enabling multi-scale feature reuse. For training, we employ the AdamW optimizer [ 22 ] with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1{\times}10^{-4} , a weight decay of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and a batch size of 32.
paragraphs.zh: D2M 分支合成以梅尔频谱图表示的音频，其中包含 256 个梅尔频率带。 VAE 编码器和解码器各由四个卷积块组成，分别用于逐步下采样和上采样，将梅尔频谱图压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。 潜在扩散模型采用 U-Net 架构，包含四层卷积编码器和对称的四层解码器，并通过跳跃连接相连，从而实现多尺度特征的重用。 在训练过程中，我们使用 AdamW 优化器 [22]，学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁴，权重衰减为 10⁻⁶，批量大小为 32。

paragraphs.en: The M2D model is the primary focus of this work and is trained with the support of the auxiliary D2M branch via a two-stage procedure. In the first stage, the D2M branch is pre-trained independently to ensure it can provide reliable cycle-consistency supervision. In the second stage, its parameters are frozen, and it is used exclusively to provide cycle-consistency supervision for M2D: dance sequences generated by M2D are passed through the frozen D2M branch to reconstruct the source music, and the resulting ℒ cycle \mathcal{L}_{\text{cycle}} is back-propagated to refine the M2D model. Throughout training, only the M2D parameters are updated.
paragraphs.zh: M2D 模型是这项工作的主要研究对象，它通过一个两阶段流程，在辅助 D2M 分支的支持下完成训练。 在第一阶段，D2M 分支被独立预训练，以确保其能够提供可靠的循环一致性监督。 在第二阶段，D2M 的参数被冻结，并仅用于为 M2D 提供循环一致性监督：由 M2D 生成的舞蹈序列会经过冻结的 D2M 分支以重构原始音乐，由此得到的循环损失项 ℒ cycle \mathcal{L}_{\text{cycle}} 会被反向传播以优化 M2D 模型。 在整个训练过程中，只有 M2D 的参数会被更新。

paragraphs.en: We follow previous methods [ 35 , 24 ] to evaluate generated dances from three dimensions: physical plausibility (PFC and PBC), diversity (Div k and Div g ), and beat alignment with music (BAS). These metrics characterize complementary aspects of visual dance quality: PFC and PBC reflect whether the motion appears physically plausible, Div k and Div g reflect the variety of generated movements, and BAS reflects whether visible motion accents follow the musical rhythm. Since no single automatic metric fully captures the perceptual quality of a dance, we interpret them jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循先前的方法 [ 35 , 24 ]，从三个维度评估生成的舞蹈：物理合理性（PFC 和 PBC）、多样性（Div k 和 Div g），以及与音乐的节拍对齐度（BAS）。 这些指标描述了视觉舞蹈质量的互补方面：PFC 和 PBC 反映动作是否看起来具有物理合理性，Div k 和 Div g 反映生成动作的多样性，而 BAS 则反映可见的动作重音是否与音乐节奏一致。 由于没有任何单一的自动指标能够完全捕捉到舞蹈的感知质量，因此我们对这些指标进行联合解读。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate diversity from two complementary perspectives: kinematic (Div k ) and geometric (Div g ). Each score is computed as the average pairwise Euclidean distance between the feature vectors of all generated sequences in the test set, calculated independently on kinematic and geometric features. Div k measures variation in motion dynamics, such as differences in velocity and acceleration patterns, whereas Div g measures variation in geometric pose and choreographic configurations. Visually, they indicate whether a model generates a broad range of movement styles and body shapes instead of repeatedly producing similar sequences. However, abnormally jittery or distorted motions can also inflate pairwise distances. Therefore, following EDGE [ 35 ] , we regard values close to the ground-truth diversity as preferable to blindly maximizing either score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个互补的视角评估多样性：运动学视角（Div k）和几何学视角（Div g）。 每个得分的计算方式是，对测试集中所有生成序列的特征向量进行成对欧氏距离的平均值，其中运动学和几何学特征分别独立计算。 Div k 衡量运动动态的变化，例如速度和加速度模式的差异，而 Div g 则衡量几何姿态和编舞配置的变化。 从视觉上看，这些指标可以反映模型是否生成了广泛多样的运动风格和身体形态，而不是重复生成相似的序列。 然而，异常抖动或扭曲的运动也可能导致成对距离被人为放大。 因此，我们遵循 EDGE [35] 的做法，认为接近真实多样性基准的数值优于盲目最大化任一得分。

paragraphs.en: BeatDance achieves state-of-the-art performance in both PFC and PBC on PopDanceSet and AIST++. Physical plausibility is a foundational criterion in dance generation: motions with foot-sliding artifacts or implausible physical dynamics are immediately perceptible to viewers, rendering them unsuitable regardless of their beat alignment or diversity. This improvement is driven by HDA and CCL in a complementary fashion. HDA models the fine-grained spatial-temporal structure of human motion. Its spatial branch learns region-specific physical dynamics through independent per-body-part projections. Its hierarchical temporal structure further ensures coherent full-body coordination across multiple scales. CCL additionally discourages physically implausible configurations by constraining the generated motion to remain semantically aligned with the source music. Together, they produce the state-of-the-art PFC and PBC scores across both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: BeatDance 在 PopDanceSet 和 AIST++ 数据集的 PFC 与 PBC 两项指标上均达到了当前最优性能。 物理合理性是舞蹈生成的一项基础标准：存在脚部滑动伪影或不合理物理动态的动作会被观众立即察觉，因此无论其节奏匹配度或多样性如何，都不适合使用。 这种改进得益于 HDA 与 CCL 的互补性协同作用。 HDA 对人类动作的精细时空结构进行了建模。 其空间分支通过每个身体部位的独立投影，学习特定区域的物理动态。 其分层时间结构进一步确保了多尺度下全身动作的连贯协调。 CCL 则通过约束生成的动作与源音乐保持语义对齐，从而避免物理上不合理的配置。 二者共同作用，使模型在两项基准测试中均获得了当前最优的 PFC 和 PBC 分数。

paragraphs.en: BeatDance also achieves state-of-the-art BAS on both PopDanceSet and AIST++. As the defining objective of music-driven dance generation, beat alignment is indispensable: a dance that fails to respond to the rhythmic structure of the music defeats the fundamental purpose of the task, regardless of its diversity. This advantage stems from the synergy between HDA and CCL. HDA equips the model with the capacity to learn fine-grained correspondences between musical rhythm and dance motion across multiple temporal scales, which is a prerequisite for precise beat synchronization. CCL then provides a direct optimization signal for this alignment. The music → \to dance → \to music round-trip can only close with low reconstruction error when the generated dance genuinely tracks the rhythmic structure of the source music. Together, the two components enforce beat-level synchronization.

paragraphs.en: BeatDance achieves the best geometric diversity (Div g ) on PopDanceSet and the best kinematic diversity (Div k ) on AIST++. Diversity is at best an auxiliary indicator , as pairwise distance can be inflated by physically implausible outlier poses. A model generating degraded motions may therefore score artificially high on this metric, a phenomenon also noted in prior work [ 24 , 31 ] . For the two metrics where we do not rank first, the gaps are readily explained. paragraphs.en: To complement the objective metrics, we conducted a pairwise user study with 20 participants using samples from the PopDanceSet test set. BeatDance was compared with POPDG and DanceEditor across multiple music clips, yielding 10 comparisons per participant and 200 pairwise judgments in total. Each pair consisted of a BeatDance result and a result from one competing method generated from the same music clip. For each pair, participants selected the dance with better overall quality while considering motion naturalness, expressiveness, and music-motion compatibility. Method identities were hidden, and both the comparison order and the left-right placement of the videos were randomized. As shown in Table 2 , BeatDance was preferred over both competing methods, demonstrating its perceptual advantage in overall dance quality.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充客观指标，我们对 PopDanceSet 测试集中的样本进行了双人对比用户研究，共有 20 名参与者。 我们在多个音乐片段中比较了 BeatDance、POPDG 和 DanceEditor，每位参与者完成了 10 次对比，总计获得了 200 项双人判断结果。 每一对比较都包含一个 BeatDance 的结果和一个由同一音乐片段生成的竞争对手方法的结果。 对于每一对比较，参与者在考虑动作自然度、表现力以及音乐与动作的兼容性后，选择了整体质量更优的舞蹈。 我们隐藏了各方法的身份，并对比较顺序以及视频在左右位置上的排列进行了随机化处理。 如表 2 所示，BeatDance 优于两种竞争对手方法，这表明它在舞蹈整体质量方面具有感知优势。

paragraphs.en: We replace DA with vanilla cross-attention to assess its contribution. As shown in Table 3 , removing DA causes a dramatic drop in PFC (1.54 → \to 15.53), PBC (7.75 → \to 6.38), and BAS (0.273 → \to 0.218). In DA, each anatomical group is assigned an independent linear projection, preserving part-specific dynamics and allowing each body region to independently align with musical rhythm. Replacing it with shared attention entangles the representations of all body parts, disrupting both local physical constraints and fine-grained music-motion correspondence. Although w/o DA achieves the highest Div k (8.9975), this is consistent with the pattern observed in Section 5.2.1 : physically implausible motions tend to inflate pairwise kinematic distance. The near-unchanged Div g (6.14 vs. 6.18) further supports this interpretation, as geometric diversity is less sensitive to such artifacts.

paragraphs.en: We remove the short-term branch of HM, retaining only long-term attention. As shown in Table 3 , the primary degradations appear in PBC (7.75 → \to 5.75) and BAS (0.273 → \to 0.240), while PFC changes only marginally (1.54 → \to 1.60). This pattern aligns with the design motivation of HM: musical beats are sub-second local events that global attention, spread over the entire sequence, lacks the temporal resolution to capture precisely. The local windows (size τ = 30 \tau{=}30 frames, i.e ., 1 second) provide short-range receptive fields that improve beat-level alignment and full-body coordination, as reflected in the BAS and PBC gains. PFC, which primarily depends on part-specific spatial modeling already provided by DA, is less sensitive to the removal of local temporal context. The slight increases in Div k and Div g (6.78 → \to 6.95 and 6.18 → \to 6.36) suggest that removing local constraints allows the model to explore a slightly broader motion distribution, at the cost of physical plausibility and rhythmic consistency.

paragraphs.en: We investigate the effect of the Taylor series expansion order used to approximate the joint music-dance attention map. As shown in Table 4 , order 3 achieves the best performance across most metrics, including PBC (7.75), Div k (6.78), Div g (6.18), and BAS (0.273). paragraphs.en: We analyze the effect of the local window size τ \tau on model performance. As shown in Table 5 , a small window ( τ = 5 \tau{=}5 ) achieves the highest PBC but the worst PFC, as the limited temporal context is insufficient to maintain global motion coherence. Conversely, a large window ( τ = 50 \tau{=}50 ) yields the best PFC but the worst BAS (0.218), as the coarse temporal resolution makes it difficult to resolve sub-second beat events. Our chosen window size of 30 achieves the best BAS (0.273) and Div g (6.18) while maintaining competitive performance across other metrics, achieving a favorable balance between local rhythmic precision and long-range motion coherence. Given that tempo varies across clips, τ = 30 \tau{=}30 should be understood as an approximate temporal context rather than a fixed musical unit such as a beat, bar, or phrase. This one-second context can cover local beat-level patterns and short motion transitions while avoiding overly coarse temporal context that weakens sensitivity to beat events. We use τ = 30 \tau{=}30 by default.

paragraphs.en: To choose the most appropriate architecture for the dance-to-music branch, we compare two widely used architectures: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) [ 6 ] and Diffusion models [ 9 ] . Each model is evaluated under two settings: operating on raw data and within a VAE [ 14 ] latent space. To evaluate rhythmic consistency and content similarity between the generated music and the ground truth, we adopt four metrics: BAS, BCS (Beats Coverage Score) [ 16 ] , BHS (Beats Hit Score) [ 16 ] , and FAD (Fréchet Audio Distance) [ 13 ] . BCS and BHS evaluate rhythmic fidelity, where BCS measures the difference in total beat count between the synthesized and reference music, and BHS examines their temporal beat alignment. FAD is used to quantify content similarity and overall audio quality. As shown in Table 6 , the VAE + Diffusion configuration achieves the best performance across all metrics, indicating its superior capability in modeling both rhythm and audio content.
paragraphs.zh: 为舞蹈转音乐分支选择最合适的架构，我们比较了两种广泛使用的架构：生成对抗网络（GAN）[ 6 ]和扩散模型 [ 9 ]。 每种模型都在两种设置下进行评估：在原始数据上运行以及在VAE [ 14 ]潜在空间内运行。 为评估生成音乐与基准音乐之间的节奏一致性和内容相似性，我们采用了四种指标：BAS、BCS（节拍覆盖得分）[ 16 ]、BHS（节拍命中得分）[ 16 ]和FAD（Fréchet音频距离）[ 13 ]。 BCS和BHS用于评估节奏保真度，其中BCS衡量合成音乐与参考音乐之间总节拍数的差异，而BHS则检查它们的节拍时间对齐情况。 FAD用于量化内容相似性和整体音频质量。 如表6所示，VAE + Diffusion配置在所有指标上均表现最佳，表明其在节奏和音频内容建模方面具有更卓越的能力。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based framework for 3D music-driven dance generation, which comprises a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) and a cycle-consistent learning (CCL) mechanism. We employ HDA to capture both long-term and short-term dependencies between the source music and the generated dance by explicitly disentangling spatial and temporal modeling. Additionally, CCL effectively enhances the music-dance consistency by an auxiliary music-to-dance-to-music task. Consequently, our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets, particularly in physical plausibility and beat alignment. Extensive experiments also show its superior performance in maintaining beat consistency. Despite these promising results, BeatDance still has several limitations. First, the effectiveness of CCL depends on the reliability of the auxiliary D2M model. Although the D2M model is independently pre-trained and the ablation study validates the practical benefit of CCL, inaccurate D2M estimation under challenging music patterns may introduce noisy or biased supervision. Second, BeatDance may show weaker beat synchronization when the input contains unseen music genres with highly complex rhythmic patterns. Future work will explore more robust D2M supervision, explicit style control, and stronger generalization to complex musical rhythms.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于扩散的三维音乐驱动舞蹈生成框架，该框架包含一个分层解耦注意力（HDA）机制和一个循环一致性学习（CCL）机制。 我们通过显式分离空间建模和时间建模，利用 HDA 捕捉源音乐与生成的舞蹈之间的长期和短期依赖关系。 此外，CCL 通过一个辅助的音乐到舞蹈再到音乐的任务，有效增强了音乐与舞蹈之间的一致性。 因此，我们提出的方法在两个基准数据集上优于近期的竞争方法，尤其是在物理合理性和节拍对齐方面表现更优。 广泛的实验还表明，该方法在保持节拍一致性方面具有卓越的性能。 尽管取得了这些令人鼓舞的结果，BeatDance 仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，CCL 的有效性取决于辅助 D2M 模型的可靠性。 虽然 D2M 模型是独立预训练的，且消融研究验证了 CCL 的实际效益，但在具有挑战性的音乐模式下，不准确的 D2M 估计可能会引入噪声或偏差的监督信号。 其次，当输入包含具有高度复杂节奏模式的新见音乐类型时，BeatDance 的节拍同步能力可能会较弱。 未来的工作将探索更稳健的 D2M 监督机制、显式的风格控制，以及对复杂音乐节奏更强的泛化能力。
